description: 2026-09-18 floor session, PERSON approach. Drive to the nearest confirmed semantic track of a person at 0.4 m/s (the operating floor) and stop with the car's front 1.1 m from the person's near edge (1.0 m until 2026-10-20, deliberately twice the then default gap 0.5; obstacle_class_margin_m {person: 0.5} raised gap_min(person) to 1.07 m, so 1.1 is now the default). mpc_corr latches the stop at object_reach_tol_m + object_stop_distance_m past that gap, so expect the car's front to REST about 1.18-1.21 m from the person's near edge (rig, measured and longest-measured braking, measured at the old 1.0 m gap and shifted by 0.1 m), up to 1.38 m with 5 cm of track jitter; never inside 1.1. Same requirements as go_to_person.json. See docs/procedures/2026-09-18_go_to_floor.md.
